_help: Every story is rewritten in our own Tamil before it is published; English sources are translated in the same pass. Choose who writes it with 'provider'. gemini = Google's free tier: get a key at aistudio.google.com (no card needed) and set GEMINI_API_KEY. anthropic = Claude: better Tamil, but every story costs money; set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Free-tier requests are rate limited and Google may use free-tier content to improve their products; whatever a run cannot finish is picked up by the next one. Set enabled to false to stop rewriting entirely (the site then publishes only your own posts).

gemini._help: Free tier. Alternatives: gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-3.1-flash-lite are faster and lighter on the quota; gemini-3.8-flash is the strongest. Lower concurrency and raise min_interval_seconds if you see rate-limit messages. thinking_level is minimal, low, medium or high — raise it if the Tamil reads poorly, lower it to stretch the free quota.

anthropic._help: Paid. claude-haiku-4-5 is much cheaper with plainer Tamil; claude-sonnet-5 sits in between. effort is low, medium or high.
